instruction: Please modify VS Code to enable automatic saving of files after a 1000ms delay.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling auto-save with 1000ms delay in VS Code. Uses existing check_json_settings metric to verify both files.autoSave='afterDelay' and files.autoSaveDelay=1000. Slightly more complex than original - requires two settings.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies both required settings (files.autoSave='afterDelay' AND files.autoSaveDelay=1000)
Correct state extraction: Uses get_vm_file to retrieve VS Code settings from the correct location (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json)
Correct comparison logic: check_json_settings metric properly validates all expected key-value pairs with exact matching
Semantically correct expected values: 'afterDelay' is the correct enum value for auto-save mode, and 1000 is the correct numeric value for milliseconds
No postconfig needed: VS Code persists settings changes automatically, so the file will be available for verification
Proper data flow: get_rule returns rules dict -> metric receives {'expected': {...}} -> extracts 'expected' key -> validates all pairs

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
